fields.System.Title: CNT-104 — Trigger a count from a zero pick
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want a location to be counted right after a picker found
nothing there, so that the error is investigated while its cause is still traceable.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given outbound.short_pick_recorded with a zero quantity, then a count task is created
  • for that location.
  • - Given an existing open count task for the location, then no second task is created.
  • - Given the triggered task, then it is prioritised above scheduled counts.
  • - Given the task, then it links to the pick that triggered it.
  • - Given the same event delivered twice, then one task is created.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, outbound |
| Tables | count_task |
| Risks | Duplicate tasks from repeated events ([doc 09 §3.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
